_source: City Government of Legazpi (https://legazpi.gov.ph/) & Official 2024 Travel Guide (City Tourism Services Unit)

attractions.name: Ibalong Heroes Monument
attractions.description: Built in honor of the Ibalong mythical heroes Baltog, Handyong, and Bantong—the three brave warriors who fought for the peace of Ibalon (the ancient name of Bicol).

attractions.name: Baltog Monument
attractions.description: A 10-foot bronze-patina statue of Baltog, the legendary chieftain and first epic warrior of the ancient Bicol Epic "Ibalon".
attractions.address: Legazpi Boulevard, Brgy. 57 Dap-Dap, Legazpi City

attractions.name: Bantog Monument
attractions.description: Statue honoring Bantog, the valiant hero of the Bicol Epic "Ibalon" who vanquished the monstrous man-beast Rabot.
attractions.address: Legazpi Boulevard, Brgy. 57 Dap-Dap, Legazpi City

attractions.name: Battle of Legazpi Pylon
attractions.description: A historic memorial to the valiant defense of Albayanos under General Vito Belarmino against American invaders on January 23, 1900.
attractions.address: Rizal St., Legazpi Port District, Legazpi City

attractions.name: Miguel Lopez de Legazpi Monument
attractions.description: Monument of Miguel Lopez de Legazpi, known as El Adelantado and El Viejo, the Basque-Spanish navigator after whom the city was named.

attractions.name: Headless Monument
attractions.description: Constructed as a solemn dedication to the unknown heroes and civilians who died and shed their blood during the Japanese military occupation.
attractions.address: Post Office Compound, Quezon Avenue, Legazpi City

attractions.name: 500 Years of Christianity Marker
attractions.description: Symbolizing 500 years of Christianity in the Philippines, featuring Magellan's cross for salvation, a faith navigator ship, and the Holy Spirit guiding missionaries.

attractions.name: Camp Simeon Ola
attractions.description: Named in honor of General Simeón Ola y Arboleda, the Philippine Revolutionary hero and last Filipino general to surrender in the Philippine-American War.

attractions.name: Padang Memorial Cross
attractions.description: Historical repository shrine at the foot of Mayon commemorating the residents who perished when catastrophic mudslides struck during Super Typhoon Reming in November 2006.

attractions.name: Albay Gulf Landing Monument
attractions.description: Built in 1995 commemorating the 50th Anniversary of the Allied American Liberation Forces landing in Legazpi City during World War II.

attractions.name: Jose Ignacio Paua Monument
attractions.description: Honors General Jose Ignacio Paua, a Chinese general in the Philippine Revolution who signed the Biak-na-Bato constitution and later relocated to Albay.

attractions.name: Mayon Volcano
attractions.description: The world's most renowned conical active volcano, soaring to an elevation of 8,189 feet with a symmetrical crater of international acclaim.

attractions.name: Ligñon Hill Nature Park
attractions.description: A 156-meter prominent volcanic hill providing 360-degree views of Mayon Volcano, Albay Gulf, and Legazpi City with WWII Japanese tunnels and viewing decks.

attractions.name: Kapuntukan Hill (Sleeping Lion)
attractions.description: Iconic scenic coastal hill resembling a slumbering lion on aerial view, presiding over Legazpi Port, Albay Gulf, and Embarcadero harbor.

attractions.name: Albay Park & Wildlife
attractions.description: Official rescue and rehabilitation sanctuary for wildlife species set amid lush botanical grounds with picnic groves and family recreational areas.

attractions.name: PRO 5 Heritage Park & Arboretum
attractions.description: Eco-friendly arboretum and conservation park fostering environmental awareness, tree preservation, and climate action in the Bicol region.

attractions.name: Sawangan Park
attractions.description: Vibrant seaside urban park and open-air fitness hub welcoming joggers, families, and sunset strollers along Legazpi Boulevard.

attractions.name: Legazpi Boulevard
attractions.description: Dubbed the "Fitness Hub of the City", a premier 4.095-kilometer coastal promenade offering panoramic views of Albay Gulf and Kapuntukan Hill.
attractions.address: Brgy. 57 Dap-Dap, Brgy. 59 Puro, Brgy. 60 Lamba, Legazpi City

attractions.name: The Obelisk
attractions.description: A stately monument erected as a joint civic project between the City Government of Legazpi and Mayon Lodge No. 61.

attractions.name: Embarcadero de Legazpi
attractions.description: World-class waterfront lifestyle hub and harbor promenade in Southern Luzon featuring retail, dining, and scenic oceanview plazas.
attractions.address: Brgy. 27 Victory Village South, Legazpi City

attractions.name: JCI Legazpi Tourism Super Marker
attractions.description: Iconic panoramic photo stop framing five natural and civic landmarks (Albay Gulf, Legazpi Boulevard, Sleeping Lion, Ligñon Hill, and Mayon).

attractions.name: Legazpi Ecological Sanitary Landfill
attractions.description: Nationally acclaimed municipal eco-facility utilizing waste-to-fertilizer technology in partnership with JICA since 2018.

attractions.name: Macabalo Bridge
attractions.description: Scenic illuminated bridge structure spanning the Macabalo river inlet along the boulevard, famous for nighttime waterfront strolls.

attractions.name: Risen Christ Statue
attractions.description: Hilltop landmark reminiscent of Rio de Janeiro’s Christ the Redeemer, strategically positioned on southern highlands facing the Pacific Ocean.

attractions.name: Albay Cathedral (St. Gregory the Great)
attractions.description: Historic Roman Catholic Cathedral and Episcopal Seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Legazpi in historic Old Albay District.
attractions.address: Albay District, Brgy. 11 Peñaranda, Legazpi City

attractions.name: St. Raphael Church
attractions.description: Centuries-old stone sanctuary in the heart of Legazpi Port District with an altar constructed out of native volcanic rock.
attractions.address: Aguinaldo St., Legazpi Port District, Legazpi City

attractions.name: Giant Statue of Nuestra Sra. de Salvacion
attractions.description: Impressive 15-meter (49-foot) tall image of the Heavenly Patroness of Albay sculpted at the northern gateway rotunda.

attractions.name: Padre Pio Church
attractions.description: Revered spiritual retreat and major pilgrimage church visited during Holy Week Visita Iglesia.

delicacies.name: Sili Ice Cream
delicacies.description: World-famous creamy artisanal ice cream infused with local bird's eye chili, ranging from Level 1 to Volcano heat.

delicacies.name: Mayon Lava Cake
delicacies.description: Decadent molten chocolate cake crowned with spicy chili ganache and volcanic red garnish mimicking Mayon's glowing lava flow.

delicacies.name: Pinangat Pasta
delicacies.description: Creative fusion pasta tossed in rich Bicolano coconut cream and savory shredded taro leaf pinangat.

delicacies.name: Sili Halo-Halo
delicacies.description: Classic Filipino shaved-ice dessert crowned with chili-infused artisanal ice cream and sweet local condiments.

delicacies.name: Pili Ensaymada
delicacies.description: Fluffy golden brioche pastry topped with rich butter, sugar, cheese, and roasted Albay pili nuts.

delicacies.name: Gulay na Pagulong
delicacies.description: Traditional indigenous Bicolano vegetable specialty simmered in fresh pure coconut milk and local spices.

delicacies.name: Sili Cheesecake
delicacies.description: Velvety baked cheesecake with a gentle spicy chili kick balanced over a crisp buttered crust.

delicacies.name: Pancit-Dinuguan Combo
delicacies.description: Time-honored Bicolano afternoon merienda pairing savory stir-fried noodles with rich savory dinuguan stew.

delicacies.name: Pili Bread & Sweets
delicacies.description: Freshly baked artisan loaves, mazapan, and glazed pastries generously studded with indigenous buttery pili nuts.
